donor_industry.caption: From itemized individual contributions over $200 reported to the FEC, grouped by the donor's self-reported employer and occupation. stands_for.caption: Grouped by Congress.gov's official policy area. Shows how they voted, not why. Final-passage, amendment, and procedural votes can mean different things; read the note for each.

stands_for.majority_rule: Party majority = the Yea/Nay side taken by most members of that party who voted Yea or Nay on that roll call, counted from the party code in the roll-call XML (all members, including ones no longer serving). Ties have no majority.

said_voted.caption: Posts are shown as written. A post is matched to a vote only when it names the bill number or the bill's official title. A post can mention a bill for many reasons.
said_voted.topic_caption: Recent posts grouped by simple keyword rules that are identical for every member (published at /x_topic_rules.json). A post listed under a topic is not claimed to be about any specific vote; a post can appear under more than one topic.

posts.text: Maybe firing FAA technicians and mechanics wasn't such a good idea? The sheer incompetence of this administration is staggering.
It’s time to take on the corruption that has taken root in our government. Let’s clean up Washington.
Some of the worst cuts to health care are set to take effect in January. We must move to stop these cuts ASAP.
It’s never been more clear: This is the people's democracy, not the politicians.
Happy Founders’ Day to the sisters of Sigma Gamma Rho Sorority, Inc.! Your commitment to uplifting the community through sisterhood, scholarship, and service is an inspiration!

This Veterans Day, I want to thank every veteran in Georgia and across the nation for their service and sacrifice in defense of our freedom.  
 
As the son of a veteran, I promise to never stop working to honor and advocate for those who have answered the call to serve.

The gerrymandered maps only work if people don’t show up.  
  
You showed up.
Happy Diwali to the Georgia community and those celebrating across the world! Wishing you all the light, happiness, and peace that this celebration brings.

We've got to get rid of these tariffs. 
We've got to end this reckless war of choice. 
And no more billionaire tax breaks.

No more political games with your health care. 
  
Reverse the health care cuts.
Unless RFK Jr. is interested in spending the next two years in front of Congressional committees, he should go ahead and resign now.
Accountability is coming for the crime syndicate operating out of the Oval Office.
Now would be a great time for Donald Trump to fire Pete Hegseth.
Today is Election Day! If you haven’t already, vote and make your voice heard!

Donald Trump wants you to think that we are at war with one another.  
  
Those with no vision traffic in division.
Praying much for my friend and colleague Senator Chris Murphy as he recovers and continues his work as a strong voice for the people of Connecticut.  Strength and grace, Chris!
Atlanta Dream, we did not get the outcome we wanted but you make us so very proud! Thanks for playing with excellence and so much heart.  The Dream is deferred, not denied.  Well done!
Happy Halloween, Georgia! Hope everyone has a fun and safe night of trick-or-treating.

Reminder: Republicans in Washington set it up so that the worst of the health care cuts take effect AFTER the midterm elections.

They are playing political games with your health care.
Billionaires should spend more on taxes and less on elections.
Georgia, today is the last day of early voting before Election Day! Get out and vote!
This administration has been a failure of leadership to the highest degree.

With the money spent on this illegal war in Iran, we could provide pre-K for every four-year-old in America.  
  
We suffer not from a poverty of resources, but a lack of moral imagination.
This administration has a simple agenda: profit for themselves and their friends.

Donald Trump and JD Vance want to make it easier to build data centers in your community without input from you. 

We need MORE guardrails, not less. https://t.co/clnn9A73v7
Pete Hegseth is absolutely unhinged. He needs to be fired TODAY.

Donald Trump doesn't even hide that he wants to seize control of our elections. 
  
It’s all part of his authoritarian project.

I’m saddened to hear of the passing of Tom Houck. 

Tom Houck was a Civil Rights legend who worked alongside Dr. King during some of the movement’s most important moments. He worked tirelessly to preserve Civil Rights history and the movement’s legacy for the rest of his life.

posts.text:
Donald Trump knows that he is failing.  
  
He is doing everything he can to hold on to power. 
  
We must not let him diminish our voice.

No money for disaster aid. 

No money for health care. 

But plenty of money for billionaire tax cuts and another war in the Middle East.
https://t.co/a2Ddrag7wI https://t.co/Oh4oIQzeNQ
RFK Jr. should be fired immediately.

In 2024, 300 billionaires and their families donated 19% of all money spent on federal elections.  
  
Billionaires should spend less on elections and more in taxes.
I am deeply saddened to learn of the passing of Air Force Tech. Sgt. Ian Patterson. I’m praying for his loved ones, fellow Airmen, and the entire Fort Stewart community as we mourn his loss.

The Trump family has turned our government into their personal piggy bank. 
  
They don't even hide their corruption.
This President chose war and now you’re paying more for everything.
Donald Trump's proudest accomplishment is taking food away from working families to give his donors another tax cut.

This is a senseless tragedy. My heart is with the children, families, educators, and entire community in Bend, Oregon. I’m mourning those we lost and praying for their families. We MUST do more to protect our children from gun violence.
https://t.co/XgKYCgvIoL https://t.co/q8y2TRFuZp

I don’t understand how my Republican colleagues could hold hands with their fellow legislators, say a long prayer, and then vote to cut a trillion dollars out of Medicaid. 
 
There ought to be a connection between what you say on Sunday and what you do on Monday.
Staying in power matters more to Donald Trump than anything else.

Heartbreaking news. My thoughts are with his loved ones, the Wesley International Academy community, and all those mourning his loss.

https://t.co/63N6aWmqeU https://t.co/eh30AX6RQa

This Indigenous Peoples day, we celebrate the heritage and lasting contributions of Indigenous communities across the country.

It's an honor to support the Indigenous communities who call Georgia home.

Whenever I'm feeling demoralized, I think of my parishioner John Lewis. 
  
He had no reason to think that he would win when he was crossing the Edmund Pettus bridge. 
  
But he just kept walking. We MUST keep walking.
"No new wars" turned out to be one of the most egregious lies ever told by a presidential candidate.
I'm carefully monitoring Hurricane Isaias. Stay safe and listen to local warnings. My office remains ready to assist those in need. https://t.co/7iuMD1BMYh

There's a reason why Donald Trump won't stop talking about 2020. 
 
He wants to create the pretense to interfere in 2026. We won't let him.

Three years ago, Israeli fathers, mothers, sons, and daughters were brutally attacked, kidnapped, and killed by Hamas terrorists. As we remember the victims lost that day and in the aftermath, I pray for a lasting peace that ensures the humanity and security of all God’s children.

RFK Jr. is a hazard to the health of the American people. 
 
He ought to resign. 
 
And if he doesn't resign, the president should fire him.

Georgia, today is the last day to register to vote before Election Day next month.

If you’re not already registered, visit https://t.co/v9yNsmtV9c to ensure your voice is heard.

I’ll see you at the polls. https://t.co/2NKL1ppvL0
Joe Biden has been out of office for nearly two years. The fact that Trump keeps talking about him tells you everything.

I’m closely following the horrifying news of a shooting in Vienna, Georgia. I’m grateful to law enforcement and first responders who arrived on the scene. May God give peace to the families of the victims and I am praying for the swift recovery of those injured. Keeping the entire community of Vienna in my thoughts.

This President wants you to think that we are at war with one another. 
 
Those with no vision traffic in division.
Donald Trump and his billionaire buddies want to squeeze the people's voices out of their own democracy. Do not let them silence you.

Democracy is the house that we all live in.  
  
Donald Trump is setting that house on fire.

Pete Hegseth is twisting scripture again. He's trying to use the words of Isaiah to wrap up power and war in sacred clothes. 

Pete Hegseth needs to study his scripture. Because Isaiah challenged government that marginalizes the poor, the widows, the orphans. He challenges corruption.

Faith, when it is authentic, stands on the margins, stands with the weak, and recognizes that all of us are children of the living God.

I'm standing with Isaiah.

Donald Trump is selling access to the presidency.

It’s blatant corruption. https://t.co/xUqkVSt2uJ

On what would have been his 102nd birthday, I’m thinking of President Jimmy Carter. As a patriot, a humanitarian, and a leader who centered human rights, he embodied what it means to make your faith come alive through public service. His legacy will long outlive us all. https://t.co/ywMVbaUCyP

People died fighting for your civil rights.  
  
Donald Trump and his Supreme Court are playing with the blood of our ancestors.

A filing lists assets, income, liabilities, and trades the member reported; it is not proof of a conflict or of wrongdoing. Dollar ranges and asset names are in the PDF. financial_disclosures.note: Senate financial disclosures are filed through efd.senate.gov, a different system from the House Clerk index used here. Senate filings are not listed yet.

conflicts.caption: These are overlaps in public records, not evidence of a deal. Lobbying can be for or against a bill, and donors' employers didn't necessarily give money.
conflicts.method: Each itemized donor dollar is counted once, under the industry of the donor's self-reported employer; an industry counts if at least one LD-2 client in it lobbied on any bill this member sponsored or voted on.
